messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — high error rate on /v1/generate (p95/p99 latency spike, increased 5xx)

incident-bot: Alert: infra.api.gateway.latency.p99 > 5s AND infra.runtime.errors.5xx_rate > 5% — auto-paging to #incidents

alex: seeing a big jump right after the midnight canary rollout — p95 from ~200ms -> 1.2s, p99 ~6s, 5xx ~12%
maria: which deploy ID?
alex: rollout r-2026-03-15-1403, commit abc1234, started canary 14:03 UTC, full ramp by 14:10
tj: do we have customer impact? any paid customers paged?
helen: support reports: multiple orgs reporting timeouts; enterprise org1+org2 seeing 502s and SDK retries failing. Severity customer-facing for a subset.
ryan: grafana snapshot: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abc123?from=164733?panel=7 — queries show backend_worker_wait > 5s and connection_queue_depth spike

ryan: query used:
```
sum(rate(runtime.worker_wait_seconds_bucket[1m])) by (le)
```

alex: repro attempt locally with k6: saw connection queues and KV cache miss rate up 10x after config change to connection pool sizing
maria: which config change?
alex: small change: max_inflight_per_worker lowered to 64 in the runtime config to reduce memory. That reduced concurrency headroom and caused queueing under ramp

helen: suggestion: rollback to previous revision, confirm impact window and notify customers
maria: agree. Immediate mitigation: rollback. @deploy-bot please run rollback to previous stable r-2026-03-15-1335
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated: service=inference-runtime, from=r-2026-03-15-1403 -> to=r-2026-03-15-1335, started at 14:13:12 UTC. ETA ~2m. (PR #789)

tj: assigning oncall (@helen) to monitor post-rollback metrics and error rates
helen: on it. watching p95/p99, 5xx, and gateway pools. tailing logs now.

helen: logs excerpt:
```
2026-03-15T14:11:56Z ERROR runtime: timeout waiting for worker after 5000ms (queue=312, max_inflight=64)
2026-03-15T14:12:01Z WARN  kvcache: miss rate 0.42 -> 0.87
```

alex: roll forward blocked — we should not roll until we have a fix. Rollback confirmed?
deploy-bot: Rollback complete at 14:15:03 UTC — services healthy and routing switched to r-2026-03-15-1335.

alex: immediate metrics: p95 back to ~220ms, p99 ~350ms, 5xx down to baseline ~0.6%
maria: excellent. timeline: 14:03 canary, 14:10 ramp, 14:11 spike detected, 14:13 rollback, 14:15 mitigation complete.

helen: support notified affected orgs (org1, org2, org3) with timeline and retries suggestion — no logged data loss, SDK clients should auto-retry.
support-bot: Support ticket created: INC-2923456789-supports, customers notified via status page and direct emails where SLA warranted.

tj: action items while hot:
- short term: revert config change to max_inflight_per_worker, re-evaluate keepalive/conn pool defaults (owner: alex)
- medium: add canary pressure guard — cap requests during canary to avoid overload, add quick abort on p95 delta > 500ms (owner: eng-sre)
- long term: add synthetic canary traffic tests for connection saturation (owner: eng-ml)

alex: attaching quick logs & local stack trace snippet:
```
runtime/worker_pool.go:line 412: panic? no, blocked on channel send
stack: goroutine 321 [semacquire]:
  runtime/chansend1()
  github.com/redwood/runtime/worker_pool.(*Pool).dispatch(0xc0003a0000)
```

maria: I'll own the incident write-up and timeline. Alex — please file config revert PR with test plan. Helen — keep monitoring for the next 3 hours and add notes to oncall.

helen: handing off monitoring to @ryan for follow-up shift. I will add incident notes to the runbook and include rollback artifacts.
ryan: ack — I'll collect more traces and follow up on root cause (why max_inflight change was pushed without perf regression test).

incident-bot: Incident resolved: rollback successful, mitigated. Impact window 14:11:00 - 14:15:03 UTC. Severity downgraded; create postmortem.

maria: filing INC-2923456789 in Jira with timeline + customer impact.
alex: note for postmortem: consider backpressure on KV cache and socket keepalive plus a canary traffic throttling gate.
maria: thanks everyone for quick ops. :thumbsup:

helen: leaving final handoff here — follow-up owners: alex (config revert), maria (postmortem), eng-sre (canary guard).
ryan: will start root cause investigation, will add findings to the ticket.

end of thread.
